audience: People who have heard of Tau Net or hold AGRS and want to see what the testnet really does; then anyone curious about a blockchain with rules in logic.
question: How do I watch the Tau Net testnet live?
title: How to watch the Tau Net testnet live, block by block

scenes.say: You do not have to take anyone's word for what this chain does. You can watch every block yourself, in a browser, with nothing to install. Here is where to look.
scenes.caption: tauhud.com

scenes.say: Start with the explorer. Every block is one bar, the newest on the right. Each bar shows what its block holds.
scenes.caption: Every block, one bar

scenes.say: Paste a transaction, a block or a wallet here, and it tells you what happened to it, in plain words.
scenes.caption: What happened to it?

scenes.say: Back on the dashboard, the feed shows what is happening this minute. Payments, rules being set, votes.
scenes.caption: Happening now

scenes.say: Watch this part. These are payments the chain refused, each with its reason. A block explorer that hides refusals hides half the story.
scenes.caption: Refused, with the reason

scenes.say: These are the nodes that carry the network, and how many are online right now.
scenes.caption: Nodes online

scenes.say: And when something is wrong, with the chain or with our own node, it stands here. Next: your first payment on the testnet.
scenes.caption: Nothing hidden

description: Where to look to see the Tau Net testnet at work: the explorer, the live feed, the payments the chain refused and why, the nodes, and the incidents.
